name: Black Lotus
description: A rare and deadly flower from the Southland jungles, its petals yield a venom prized by assassins and blade masters.

name: Heartkill
description: A lethal concoction of serpent and Jabberslythe venoms, completely colourless and odourless, feared in every court and back alley.

name: Mad Cap Mushrooms
description: Small, cap-shaped fungi that induce berserker rage in Goblin fanatics when consumed before battle.

name: Mandrake Root
description: A twisted root harvested beneath gallows, chewed to calm restless minds with its powerful, addictive properties.

name: Moonflower
description: A rare mossy flower from Laurelorn, used by Elves to soothe the sick and treat the Black Plague.

name: Ranald’s Delight
description: A highly-addictive stimulant, concocted from sulphur and mercury, coveted by thieves and gamblers in the Empire.

name: Spit
description: A hallucinogenic fluid from Chameleoleeches, inducing visions of lost loves or forgotten desires, sought by the desperate.

name: Weirdroot
description: A common street-drug that brings euphoria and strange visions, whispered to connect with the Winds of Magic.

name: Digestive Tonic
description: A bitter herbal concoction that eases the belly and strengthens the constitution of weary travellers and soldiers.

name: Earth Root
description: A potent herb ingested to counter the Buboes of Black Plague, though the swellings still mar the flesh.

name: Faxtoryll
description: An herbal coagulant applied to wounds, halting bleeding without any need for skill or a Heal Test.

name: Healing Draught
description: A restorative potion that revitalizes the body, treasured by adventurers and soldiers alike.

name: Healing Poultice
description: A foul-smelling wrap of herbs, dung, and urine, surprisingly effective at staunching wounds and easing pain.

name: Nightshade
description: A sinister herb that lulls its victim into a deep, unnatural sleep after a few hours, prized by assassins.

name: Salwort
description: A crushed sprig emits an aroma that instantly clears a stunned mind, favored by healers and battlefield medics.

name: Vitality Draught
description: A shimmering potion that instantly restores vigor and removes fatigue, prized by warriors and adventurers alike.
